_README: THE DENSITY. Tap target, padding, gaps, line length.
AN ABSENT KEY INHERITS. A PRESENT KEY WINS.
`touch` is an ACCESSIBILITY FLOOR, not a taste dial. 44px minimum. The menu
rows, the password field and the Unlock button all read it.
`pad-row` is vertical then horizontal, like any CSS padding pair.

_base.note: The fallback every other row lands on. Must be complete.

dense.note: Tighter. More rows on screen, less air. Keeps the 44px tap floor.

roomy.note: More air. Easier at distance and on a phone in a dark theatre.
